description: For a merchant who enters their bare domain (for example brand.com): points www at their Bravo online store, adds the TXT record that proves www is theirs, and forwards the bare domain to https://www with a permanent redirect. Applied at the zone apex, without a host.
variableDescription: token: the store's verification token for the www host, 32 hexadecimal characters, made by Bravo when the merchant adds the domain. Apply without host.
